aliases: atlassian certified in managing jira projects for cloud
exam_name: Atlassian Certified in Managing Jira Projects for Cloud
exam_rules: Closed-book. No notes or reference materials. Online proctored or in-person at Pearson VUE. Webcam and microphone required for online proctoring.
id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID required. Name must match registration exactly.

lifecycle.summary: Atlassian's own learning hub lists the certification among its live prep tracks: 'Prepare for the Managing Jira Projects for Cloud certification - Refresh your knowledge of how to create and configure a Jira project according to your team's requirements with these helpful courses and study resources.' The hub also lists the Atlassian Certified Associate and Professional families; no retirement language.

official_study_resources.notes: Official learning paths and practice tests
official_study_resources.title: Atlassian University

renewal_options: Certifications valid for 2 years. Recertify by passing the current exam version or completing approved continuing education.

retake_policy.notes: 14-day waiting period between attempts. Full exam fee required for retake.

testing_centers.notes: Online and in-person proctored via Pearson VUE
